description:
Sydney's Edseven enters the Inner Tribe with a super soulful collab with New York vocalist Tan Brown. 

The EP 'MGIC' skirts Neo Soul, 90's Rnb Bounce and future leaning rhythms... lush chords, swung boom bap and Tan Brown's distinct voice floating overhead. 'I Need You To' featuring Detroit native Phat Kat as special guest waxing lyrical. 

To round out the EP, Edseven has enlisted two Sydney dons on remixes (Vinyl first, digital later)- Steve Spacek and Peret Mako, both providing their own distinct take on the originals. 

Ed is no newbie to the game, a longstanding Sydney DJ who has opened for the likes of Gilles Peterson, Norman Jay, Dego, Roy Ayers, Tim Sweeney, Seven Davis Jr, IG Culture, Recloose, Grooveman Spot, Nickodemus, Suff Daddy, Linkwood, Mark de Clive Lowe, Peanut Butter Wolf, Jose James, Waajeed, James Pants, Domu and countless others. 

He also has a hefty back catalogue under his belt with previous releases on City Fly, Turntables on The Hudson and Low Key Source. 

MGIC is the definitive sound of Edseven, a remarkable Neo-soul leaning EP that is sure to make its mark on the worldwide music community. 

Already receiving early industry support from the likes of Robert Luis (Tru Thoughts), 6th Borough Project, Bill Brewster, Selectors ensemble crew, Simon Caldwell, Ennio Styles, Kaspar, Cottam, Basic Soul Show and Kid Fonque!

01. MGIC feat. Tan Brown
02. Heart Wars
03. I Need You To feat. Tan Brown & Phat Kat
04. I Need You To (Dancefloor Dub)

All tracks produced by edseven.
Vocals by Tan Brown & Phat Kat.
Mastered by Beyond June
2021 (c) Inner Tribe Records
